1.2 Installing

diskproxy builds with Rust and Cargo. The launcher uses only tools included with macOS: zsh, hdiutil, diskutil, plutil, mount_nfs, ps and nohup. The server builds on any Unix, but automatic mounting is macOS only.

git clone https://github.com/firstpair/diskproxy.git
cd diskproxy
scripts/install.sh --config configs/passthrough.json

The installer builds a release binary and places the diskproxy launcher, the diskproxy-server binary and the older pmp-card compatibility commands in ~/bin; make sure that folder is on your PATH. It seeds ~/.config/diskproxy/config.json from the chosen example only if no default config exists yet, so reinstalling never overwrites your settings. The examples in configs/ are:

Example Plugin and mode
passthrough.json A plain read-only disk of a folder
pmp.json Camera-card ingest for Photo Mechanic Plus
pmp-filtered.json The same, hiding photos already ingested
previews.json A stand-in tree with embedded previews

To update, pull and run scripts/install.sh again. Stop a running session first, so the new binary is used from the next start.
